description: This file contains utility functions for string formatting, specifically converting strings to camelCase and Title Case, used across the application's UI to ensure consistent string rendering.

methods.name: toCamelCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to camelCase, handling spaces, underscores, hyphens, and collapsing multiple whitespace. Preserves non-string inputs.

methods.name: toTitleCaseName(value)
methods.description: Converts a string to Title Case for display, handling delimiters, apostrophes, accented characters, and collapsing multiple whitespace. Preserves non-string inputs.
